text:
1. 11. 10. 

Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū paññattaṃ tathāgatena paññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti, te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Bahuñca te bhikkhave bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti, tevimaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentīti.84 

Vaggo ekādasamo.85

12. Anāpattivaggo
